qualification.reason: Analytic diagnostic only: unresolved native paths, image capacity, priced attention and tile delivery prevent a production layer run.

composition.rule: stages in dependency order; each lowered family span from its own compiled schedule (RTL-measured ages, benched on its edges); the ctlm plan gaps between dependent ops kept; attention = ctlm price (KV die); all-reduce = measured TP8 collective E (+2 LS 378); chained period = residual-2 x stream end + PC15->PC16 gap - PC1 issue; L0 cold = stage-0 embedding + layer latency

stages.source: dv_lower (slice_ages.json measured); r of PC2 = fused ROOT (no command)

stages.stage: qkv matvec L9 -> VM QKV (column tiles + STN)
stages.source: dv_lower_mat STN (stn_ages.json); tile_first 40 = ME issue -> first far word (PARAMETER: no tool compiles the xhead / ROM tile delivery)
ctlm plan price: the KV die step is QW-KVATTN (not composed from a measurement here)

stages.stage: o_proj matvec L8 -> AR words + XC (column tiles + STN)

stages.stage: residual 1: AR landing + post-scale + add + SSQ + x stream (DV)

stages.stage: gate/up matvec L7 -> VM GU (column tiles + STN)

composition.l0_cold_rule: embedding 256 words landed + x stream (resid XS span) + PC15->PC16 gap + layer (qkv issue .. residual-2 x stream end)

embed_stage0.rule: arm enters t_b - s - 1, disarm t_b + 7 - s (t_b = word 8 b at the W5 return pin)

gaps: IMAGE CAPACITY: the full layer needs 13910 PW words (calendar 822 + tables 12608 = (PROG 72 + BTAB 188 + CROM 528) x 16) > CMD_CEIL 976: tt_ctlm cannot hold one layer's slice tables + calendar; and CROM post-scales / norm gains differ per layer (36 x) -> a per-layer table stream (ROM-resident slice tables or a table DMA) is needed

ATTENTION OUTPUT PATH (PC11 -> PC12): the KV die returns the attention output on the D2D return chain; no lowering lands it / streams it to the o_proj column heads (PORTS dd_en windows + x-stream of the 512 attn elements are not emitted by any family)

COLUMN-HEAD x CONSUMER: the qkv / gu / down / o matvecs read x from the slice x stream; the hr / xpf control that makes the column heads tap those words on the compiled edges is not lowered (QLB-C4b/3a left)
TILE DELIVERY: tile_first 40 (ME issue -> first far cluster word) and the AR stagger (slice s gets block b at M0 + 8 b + j - 26 - 2 s) are a contract no tool compiles into the ME / xhead calendar
PER-TOKEN RoPE ROW: cos / sin of the position must reach CROM ROPE every token; TLOAD plays static image blocks only (no producer of the per-token row on the die)
AR TAG CONTRACT (dv_lower_mat RTL gap): io_collective needs tag == cmd tag on every word and last only on the message last word; slice2 sends tag = row address, last per STN op (fault_code[2])
notes: XC ORDER: CLOSED in the spliced calendar (o / down XC at word0 - XC_TO_WORD0 - xc_cc: 2469 / 4454 vs word0 2473 / 4458); ctlm_image XC-after-END is the priced plan only and is not emitted
